SELECT pr.id, pr.return_no AS returnNo, pr.purchase_id AS purchaseId, p.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, pr.goods_id AS goodsId, pr.batch_id AS batchId, pr.batch_no AS batchNo, pr.return_count AS returnCount, (pr.return_count * COALESCE(gb.purchase_price, 0)) AS returnAmount, pr.reason, pr.status, pr.creator_id AS creatorId, u1.name AS creatorName, pr.auditor_id AS auditorId, u2.name AS auditorName, g.name AS goodsName, pr.create_time AS createTime, pr.audit_time AS auditTime FROM purchase_return pr LEFT JOIN purchase p ON pr.purchase_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user u1 ON pr.creator_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON pr.auditor_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN goods g ON pr.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN goods_batch gb ON pr.batch_id = gb.id
AND pr.return_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{returnNo}, '%')
AND pr.status = #{status}
ORDER BY pr.create_time DESC, pr.id DESC
